description: Deterministic local search flow used for primary token and latency comparisons.
promptTemplate: Use the {{DRIVER_SKILL}} skill and {{DRIVER_LABEL}} CLI for every browser interaction. Open a fresh {{BROWSER_MODE}} Chrome session, navigate to {{BASE_URL}}/, use the visible search form to search for Telerik, open the first result, and return its page heading and current URL as title and url. Do not navigate directly to a result URL. Immediately before closing, capture the final visible page as final-screenshot.png using {{DRIVER_LABEL}}. Close the browser session before answering.
